results.question: open dataset for bipolar syndrome or schizophrenia
results.explanation: Find open datasets for participants with bipolar syndrome or schizophrenia.
results.sql:
SELECT tier_base.*, ut.uncertain_level, ut.uncertain_reasons
FROM (
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE (((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.diagnosis IN ('schizophrenia', 'schizophrenia_with_avh', 'schizophrenia_without_avh')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'schizophrenia:AB | schizophrenic:AB | psychosis:AB | psychotic:AB | schizoprenia:AB | schizofrenia:AB')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syndrome')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'schizophrenia | schizophrenic | psychosis | psychotic | schizoprenia | schizofrenia') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'schizophrenia | schizophrenic | psychosis | psychotic | schizoprenia | schizofrenia')) OR (d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syndrome') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syndrome'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(schizophrenia | schizophrenic | psychosis | psychotic | schizoprenia | schizofrenia)')))) GROUP BY d.id
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT us.u0 AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN '"schizophrenia" / "schizophrenic" … appears only further down in the README' WHEN us.u0 = 2 THEN 'diagnosis not recorded' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
         (CASE WHEN us.u0 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unsure, (us.u0 <= 1) AS has_evidence
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.diagnosis IN ('schizophrenia', 'schizophrenia_with_avh', 'schizophrenia_without_avh')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'schizophrenia:AB | schizophrenic:AB | psychosis:AB | psychotic:AB | schizoprenia:AB | schizofrenia:AB')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syndrome')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'schizophrenia | schizophrenic | psychosis | psychotic | schizoprenia | schizofrenia') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'schizophrenia | schizophrenic | psychosis | psychotic | schizoprenia | schizofrenia')) OR (d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syndrome') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syndrome'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(schizophrenia | schizophrenic | psychosis | psychotic | schizoprenia | schizofrenia)'))) THEN 1 WHEN NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS uk WHERE uk.dataset_id = d.id AND uk.diagnosis IS NOT NULL)) THEN 9 ELSE 9 END AS u0,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'schizophrenia | schizophrenic | psychosis | psychotic | schizoprenia | schizofrenia') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'schizophrenia | schizophrenic | psychosis | psychotic | schizoprenia | schizofrenia')) OR (d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syndrome') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syndrome'))) AS p0
    FROM bids_datasets AS d WHERE d.id = tier_base.id
  ) AS us
) AS ut
WHERE ut.uncertain_level < 9 AND ut.n_unsure <= 1 AND ut.has_evidence

SELECT tier_base.*, ut.uncertain_level, ut.uncertain_reasons
FROM (
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND (o2.datatype = 'electroencephalography' OR o2.suffix = 'eeg'))) AND ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.diagnosis IN ('alzheimers_disease')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer:AB | alzheimers:AB | (alzhiemer:AB & disease:AB) | (alzeimer:AB & disease:AB)')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease)') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease)'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease))')))) GROUP BY d.id
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT us.u0 AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN '"alzheimer" / "alzheimers" … appears only further down in the README' WHEN us.u0 = 2 THEN 'diagnosis not recorded' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
         (CASE WHEN us.u0 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unsure, (us.u0 <= 1) AS has_evidence
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.diagnosis IN ('alzheimers_disease')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer:AB | alzheimers:AB | (alzhiemer:AB & disease:AB) | (alzeimer:AB & disease:AB)')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease)') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease)'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', '(alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease))'))) THEN 1 WHEN NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS uk WHERE uk.dataset_id = d.id AND uk.diagnosis IS NOT NULL)) THEN 9 ELSE 9 END AS u0,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease)') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'alzheimer | alzheimers | (alzhiemer & disease) | (alzeimer & disease)'))) AS p0
    FROM bids_datasets AS d WHERE d.id = tier_base.id
  ) AS us
) AS ut
WHERE ut.uncertain_level < 9 AND ut.n_unsure <= 1 AND ut.has_evidence

results.sql: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o_epi WHERE o_epi.dataset_id = d.id AND o_epi.suffix = 'bold' AND o_epi.datatype = 'functional_mri' AND NOT o_epi.other_entities ->> 'RepetitionTime' IS NULL AND CASE WHEN (o_epi.other_entities ->> 'RepetitionTime') ~ '^[[:space:]]*[-+]?([0-9]+[.]?[0-9]*|[.][0-9]+)([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?[[:space:]]*$' THEN CAST((o_epi.other_entities ->> 'RepetitionTime') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END > 1.5) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o_t1w WHERE o_t1w.dataset_id = d.id AND o_t1w.suffix = 't1w' AND o_t1w.datatype = 'anatomical_mri') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o_rest WHERE o_rest.dataset_id = d.id AND o_rest.task = 'resting_state') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o_voxels WHERE o_voxels.dataset_id = d.id AND o_voxels.suffix = 'bold' AND o_voxels.datatype = 'functional_mri' AND NOT o_voxels.other_entities ->> 'VoxelSize' IS NULL AND CASE WHEN (o_voxels.other_entities ->> 'VoxelSize') ~ '^[[:space:]]*[-+]?([0-9]+[.]?[0-9]*|[.][0-9]+)([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?[[:space:]]*$' THEN CAST((o_voxels.other_entities ->> 'VoxelSize') AS DOUBLE PRECISION) END < 4.1) GROUP BY d.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) > 12

results.question: BIDS-valid MRI datasets on language with more than 50 healthy adults and a published data descriptor
results.explanation: Find BIDS-valid MRI datasets focused on language, with more than 50 healthy adult participants, and a published data descriptor (DOI).
results.sql:
SELECT tier_base.*, ut.uncertain_level, ut.uncertain_reasons
FROM (
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND (o2.datatype IN ('functional_mri', 'anatomical_mri', 'diffusion_mri', 'field_maps', 'perfusion_asl') OR o2.suffix IN ('t1_weighted_mri', 't2_weighted_mri', 'fmri_bold', 'bold_map', 'single_band_reference', 'bold_reference', 't2_star_weighted_mri', 'flair_mri')))) AND (NOT d.doi IS NULL) AND ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.task IN ('language_control', 'semantic_categorization', 'temporal_community_structure_analysis', 'overt_word_repetition', 'music_listening', 'picture_naming_task', 'analogical_reasoning', 'darkend_auditory_narrative_listening_1', 'semantic_mnemonic_similarity_task', 'delay_discounting_task', 'mixed_gambles_task', 'food_choice_task', 'word_memory_encoding', 'social_observation', 'rhyme_judgment_task', 'spatial_span_immediate_working_memory', 'phonological_processing', 'categorized_free_recall_variant_1', 'probabilistic_classification_learning', 'deterministic_classification_learning', 'single_task_weather_prediction', 'dual_task_weather_prediction', 'word_reading_semantic')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'language:AB')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'language') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'language'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'language')))) GROUP BY d.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) >= 50
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT us.u0 AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN '"language" appears only further down in the README' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
         (CASE WHEN us.u0 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unsure, (us.u0 <= 1) AS has_evidence
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.task IN ('language_control', 'semantic_categorization', 'temporal_community_structure_analysis', 'overt_word_repetition', 'music_listening', 'picture_naming_task', 'analogical_reasoning', 'darkend_auditory_narrative_listening_1', 'semantic_mnemonic_similarity_task', 'delay_discounting_task', 'mixed_gambles_task', 'food_choice_task', 'word_memory_encoding', 'social_observation', 'rhyme_judgment_task', 'spatial_span_immediate_working_memory', 'phonological_processing', 'categorized_free_recall_variant_1', 'probabilistic_classification_learning', 'deterministic_classification_learning', 'single_task_weather_prediction', 'dual_task_weather_prediction', 'word_reading_semantic')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'language:AB')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'language') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'language'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'language'))) THEN 1 ELSE 9 END AS u0,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'language') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'language'))) AS p0
    FROM bids_datasets AS d WHERE d.id = tier_base.id
  ) AS us
) AS ut
WHERE ut.uncertain_level < 9 AND ut.n_unsure <= 1 AND ut.has_evidence

results.question: Simon task fMRI healthy adults

SELECT tier_base.*, ut.uncertain_level, ut.uncertain_reasons
FROM (
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND (o2.datatype = 'functional_mri' OR o2.suffix = 'fmri_bold'))) AND ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.task = 'simon_task') OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'simon:AB')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'simon') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'simon'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'simon')))) AND ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.diagnosis = 'healthy_control') OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'healthy:AB & control:AB')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'healthy & control') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'healthy & control'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'control')))) AND ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_participants AS p2 WHERE p2.dataset_id = d.id AND p2.age >= 18) OR d.age_min >= 18) OR (d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'adult | adults | (older <-> adults) | (older <-> adult) | (older <-> participants) | elderly | geriatric | seniors | (old <-> age)'))) GROUP BY d.id
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT GREATEST(us.u0, us.u1, us.u2) AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN '"simon" appears only further down in the README' END, CASE WHEN us.u1 = 1 AND us.p1 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u1 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: healthy' WHEN us.u1 = 2 THEN 'diagnosis not recorded' END, CASE WHEN us.u2 = 1 THEN 'ages not recorded; the description names the age group' WHEN us.u2 = 2 THEN 'ages not recorded' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,

  FROM (

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND (o2.datatype = 'functional_mri' OR o2.suffix = 'fmri_bold'))) AND ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.task IN ('semantic_listening', 'audiobooks_and_podcasts', 'narrative_listening', 'spoken_word_perception_listen02')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'story:AB & listening:AB')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'story & listening') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'story & listening'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'story')))) AND ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.task = 'grammatical_processing') OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syntactic:AB')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syntactic') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syntactic'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syntactic')))) AND ((d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'naturalistic')) OR ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'naturalistic') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'naturalistic')))) AND ((d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'spoken & narratives')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'spoken & narratives') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'spoken & narratives'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'spoken')))) GROUP BY d.id
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT GREATEST(us.u0, us.u1, us.u2, us.u3) AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: listening' END, CASE WHEN us.u1 = 1 AND us.p1 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u1 = 1 THEN '"syntactic" appears only further down in the README' END, CASE WHEN us.u2 = 1 AND us.p2 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' END, CASE WHEN us.u3 = 1 AND us.p3 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u3 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: narratives' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
         (CASE WHEN us.u0 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN us.u1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN us.u2 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN us.u3 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unsure, (us.u0 <= 1 OR us.u1 <= 1 OR us.u2 <= 1 OR us.u3 <= 1) AS has_evidence
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.task IN ('semantic_listening', 'audiobooks_and_podcasts', 'narrative_listening', 'spoken_word_perception_listen02')) OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'story:AB & listening:AB')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'story & listening') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'story & listening'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'story'))) THEN 1 ELSE 9 END AS u0,
      CASE WHEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.task = 'grammatical_processing') OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syntactic:AB')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syntactic') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syntactic'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syntactic'))) THEN 1 ELSE 9 END AS u1,
      CASE WHEN (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'naturalistic')) THEN 0 WHEN ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'naturalistic') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'naturalistic'))) THEN 1 ELSE 9 END AS u2,
      CASE WHEN (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'spoken & narratives')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'spoken & narratives') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'spoken & narratives'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'spoken'))) THEN 1 ELSE 9 END AS u3,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'story & listening') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'story & listening'))) AS p0,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syntactic') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'syntactic'))) AS p1,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'naturalistic') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'naturalistic'))) AS p2,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'spoken & narratives') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'spoken & narratives'))) AS p3
    FROM bids_datasets AS d WHERE d.id = tier_base.id
  ) AS us
) AS ut
WHERE ut.uncertain_level < 9 AND ut.n_unsure <= 1 AND ut.has_evidence

  SELECT GREATEST(us.u0, us.u1, us.u2) AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: fmri' END, CASE WHEN us.u1 = 1 AND us.p1 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u1 = 1 THEN '"control" / "healthy" … appears only further down in the README' WHEN us.u1 = 2 THEN 'diagnosis not recorded' END, CASE WHEN us.u2 = 1 AND us.p2 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,

  SELECT GREATEST(us.u0, us.u1) AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN '"sleep" appears only further down in the README' END, CASE WHEN us.u1 = 1 AND us.p1 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u1 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: scoring, sleep' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.accession_id, d.bids_version, d.dataset_type, d.source_type, d.remote_url, d.validation_status, d.authors, d.institutions, d.description_text, COUNT(DISTINCT o.subject) AS subject_count FROM bids_datasets AS d LEFT JOIN bids_objects AS o ON o.dataset_id = d.id AND NOT o.subject IS NULL WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND (o2.datatype = 'functional_mri' OR o2.suffix = 'fmri_bold'))) AND ((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.task = 'emotion_evaluation_task') OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotion:AB & ratings:AB')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotion & ratings') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotion & ratings'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotion')))) AND ((d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'clips & video & emotional')) OR (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'clips & video & emotional') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'clips & video & emotional'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'clips & video')))) GROUP BY d.id
) AS tier_base
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT GREATEST(us.u0, us.u1) AS uncertain_level, NULLIF(CONCAT_WS('; ', CASE WHEN us.u0 = 1 AND us.p0 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u0 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: ratings' END, CASE WHEN us.u1 = 1 AND us.p1 THEN 'found only in a paper the dataset names' WHEN us.u1 = 1 THEN 'matches only part of the search; missing: emotional' END), '') AS uncertain_reasons,
         (CASE WHEN us.u0 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN us.u1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unsure, (us.u0 <= 1 OR us.u1 <= 1) AS has_evidence
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bids_objects AS o2 WHERE o2.dataset_id = d.id AND o2.task = 'emotion_evaluation_task') OR d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotion:AB & ratings:AB')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotion & ratings') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotion & ratings'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotion'))) THEN 1 ELSE 9 END AS u0,
      CASE WHEN (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'clips & video & emotional')) THEN 0 WHEN (((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'clips & video & emotional') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'clips & video & emotional'))) OR (d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'clips & video'))) THEN 1 ELSE 9 END AS u1,
      ((d.search_tsv_papers @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotion & ratings') AND NOT d.search_tsv @@ TO_TSQUERY('english', 'emotion & ratings'))) AS p0,
